tagline: Central Bank Regulated Instant Remittances & Corporate Treasury Rails
problem: Cross-border B2B corporate payments across the GCC and South Asia suffer 3-5 day settlement delays and 4-6% hidden FX markups, trapping $18B in working capital for UAE trading and logistics conglomerates.
solution: Oasis Pay connects directly to the UAE Central Bank AANI instant transfer network and regional RTGS rails to enable real-time sub-second dirham settlements at 0.45% flat transaction fees.
businessModel: B2B SaaS subscription for treasury portal plus dynamic basis-point FX spread on high-volume corridor transactions.
traction: AED 120M ($32.6M) annualized transaction volume, licensed under DIFC DFSA Sandbox, 45 corporate merchants onboarded.
moat: Direct AANI regulatory integration, proprietary bilateral banking corridors with India and Philippines, UAE PASS biometric sign-in.
founders: Tariq Al-Mansoor (Ex-Emirates NBD Head of Treasury) & Sarah Jenkins (Ex-Revolut Head of Compliance MENA).
